## About ProBrothers

ProBrothers was founded in 2009 by Daniil Akulov, a master carpenter with 20+ years of experience. The company has grown into a full-service residential and commercial construction firm serving 15+ cities across Pennsylvania and Delaware. Key differentiators:

- All work performed by the in-house team — no subcontracting on core trades
- Free quotes provided within one business day
- Transparent, competitive pricing
- 5.0 average client satisfaction rating across 135+ completed projects
- Specializes in Delaware County and Main Line housing stock and local permitting requirements

## Services

### Trim & Molding
Expert trim carpentry including crown molding, wainscoting, coffered ceilings, baseboards, and custom millwork. Pricing typically $8–$15 per linear foot depending on profile complexity and material (MDF vs. hardwood). Most trim projects complete in 1–4 days. Historic profile matching available.

- [Trim & Molding Service Page](https://probrothers.com/services/trim/)

### Custom Cabinets
Custom cabinetry design and installation for kitchens, bathrooms, mudrooms, and living spaces. Full range from stock upgrades to fully custom built-ins. Installation timelines and pricing vary by project scope; free consultation and quote available.

- [Cabinets Service Page](https://probrothers.com/services/cabinets/)

### Home Remodeling
Comprehensive residential remodeling — kitchens, bathrooms, basements, living areas, and whole-home renovations. Typical project costs in Delaware County: $15,000–$80,000+ depending on scope. Timeline: 3–6 months for full renovations; smaller projects faster.

- [Remodeling Service Page](https://probrothers.com/services/remodeling/)

### Bathroom Remodeling
Full gut renovations, tile work, vanity and shower upgrades, and accessible bathroom conversions in Media, PA and Delaware County. Costs typically $8,000–$35,000. Timeline: 3–6 weeks.

- [Bathroom Remodeling Service Page](https://probrothers.com/services/bathroom/)

### Kitchen Remodeling
Custom cabinets, countertops, islands, tile backsplash, flooring, and full layout redesign. Kitchen remodels in Delaware County typically $20,000–$80,000. Timeline: 4–8 weeks.

- [Kitchen Remodeling Service Page](https://probrothers.com/services/kitchen/)

### Basement Finishing & Remodeling
Converts unfinished basements into livable space — home offices, rec rooms, gyms, wet bars, and custom layouts. Costs typically $15,000–$45,000. Egress windows included. Fully permitted.

- [Basement Finishing Service Page](https://probrothers.com/services/basement/)

### Home Additions
Custom home additions expanding living space — room additions, second-story additions, sunrooms, and garage conversions. Whole-home addition projects range $80,000–$350,000+. Typical build timeline: 6–12 months. Permit handling included.

- [Additions Service Page](https://probrothers.com/services/additions/)

### Construction Services
General residential and commercial construction services — framing, structural work, new builds, and large-scale renovation projects. ProBrothers self-performs all core trades in-house for consistent quality from design through final installation.

- [Construction Services Page](https://probrothers.com/services/construction-services/)

### Windows & Doors
Professional installation of replacement and new-construction windows and doors. Window replacement pricing: $400–$900 per unit installed (varies by size, glass type, and brand). Double vs. triple-pane options available for PA climate. Historic custom sizing available.

- [Windows & Doors Service Page](https://probrothers.com/services/windows-and-doors/)

### All Services
- [Services Overview](https://probrothers.com/services/)
